caption:
Trial Reels show your video only to people who don't follow you. You see how cold traffic responds, then decide whether it deserves your actual audience.

Think about what that removes. The single biggest reason people stop experimenting is the fear of a flop sitting on their grid, in front of the people whose opinion they care about. Trial Reels delete that fear entirely.

Mosseri has been direct about it: "Trials are not going to hurt your account." And since April 2026 you can schedule them too.

One catch that trips everybody up, and it's the reason Trial Reels get blamed for "low reach": compare trials to other trials, never to your normal Reels. A trial only goes to strangers, so of course the raw numbers look worse. You're reading a different audience, not a worse post.

Mosseri's other advice on the same point: keep trying new formats, because what works one week may not resonate the next. You cannot discover that by posting the same thing carefully forever.

Test on strangers. Publish the winners.
